Bulk RNA-seq graph-cluster inference

Source: R/leviRNAseqInference.R
leviBulkGraphInference.Rd

Fits a DESeq2 negative-binomial model to raw counts, projects the signed Wald statistic onto a biological graph, and assigns maximum-cluster-mass P-values by permuting sample labels. It is intended for a two-group design without additional covariates. When `blocks` is supplied, the block is included as a fixed effect in the DESeq2 model and labels are permuted only within blocks. This supports paired two-condition studies.

leviBulkGraphInference(
  counts,
  groups,
  networkCoordinatesInput,
  networkInteractionsInput = NA,
  fileTypeInput = "dat",
  test = unique(groups)[2],
  control = unique(groups)[1],
  threshold = 2,
  n_perm = 999L,
  blocks = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  permutation_method = c("auto", "monte_carlo", "exact"),
  max_exact = 50000L,
  refit_dispersions = FALSE,
  BPPARAM = SerialParam()
)

Arguments

counts

Integer genes-by-samples count matrix with gene row names.

groups

Two-level group vector.

networkCoordinatesInput, networkInteractionsInput, fileTypeInput

Network inputs.

test, control

Group labels defining test minus control.

threshold

Absolute Wald-statistic threshold for graph components.

n_perm

Number of sample-label permutations.

blocks

Optional exchangeability blocks.

seed

Optional RNG seed.

permutation_method

`"auto"`, `"monte_carlo"` or `"exact"`. `"exact"` enumerates every distinct label assignment; `"monte_carlo"` draws `n_perm` random permutations; `"auto"` uses the exact scheme when the number of assignments is at most `max_exact` and Monte Carlo otherwise.

max_exact

Maximum number of label assignments enumerated by the exact permutation scheme.

refit_dispersions

Logical. `FALSE` (default) keeps the size factors and dispersions estimated on the observed labels and refits only the negative-binomial GLM in each permutation, a test conditional on those estimates and considerably faster. `TRUE` re-estimates dispersions in every permutation.

BPPARAM

A [BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam] object controlling how the permutations are evaluated. The default runs them serially.

Value

List containing the DESeq2 statistic, graph regions, null maxima and the dispersion estimator used (`"trend"` for the standard `DESeq()` pipeline, `"genewise"` when the trend could not be fitted).

Details

For a fast alternative on the same design, transform the counts with `limma::voom()` or `edgeR::cpm(log = TRUE)` and use [leviGraphClusterInference()], whose moderated t refits in milliseconds.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("DESeq2", quietly = TRUE)) {
# \donttest{
  set.seed(3)
  genes <- c("HUB", paste0("N", 1:8))
  counts <- matrix(rpois(length(genes) * 6, 30), length(genes), 6,
    dimnames = list(genes, paste0("s", 1:6)))
  counts[, 4:6] <- counts[, 4:6] + 30L
  out <- leviBulkGraphInference(counts, c("C", "C", "C", "T", "T", "T"),
    system.file("extdata", "hub_network.dat", package = "levi"),
    test = "T", control = "C", threshold = 1, n_perm = 3, seed = 1)
  out$regions$summary
# }
}
